title: Abdomen & Pelvic Aids
description: Abdominal belts, maternity supports, pelvic belts, and hernia belts for core support, post-surgical recovery, and pelvic stability.

products.name: Abdomen Belt
features: Wide elastic panel provides firm abdominal compression
Hook-and-loop closure allows adjustable tension throughout the day
Breathable fabric reduces skin irritation during prolonged wear
Low-profile design sits flat under clothing
benefits: Supports the abdominal wall after surgery to reduce incisional tension
Minimises post-operative pain during movement, coughing, and ambulation
Helps manage abdominal muscle weakness and mild hernia discomfort
Reduces post-surgical swelling by maintaining gentle compression

products.name: Maternity Belt
features: Ergonomic design supports the growing uterus from below
Breathable stretch fabric accommodates changing body shape throughout pregnancy
Adjustable velcro panel for a personalised fit across trimesters
Soft seamless construction prevents dig-in points at the abdomen
benefits: Relieves lower back and pelvic girdle pain during pregnancy
Reduces downward pressure on the pelvic floor from the growing baby
Supports round ligaments to ease associated pelvic discomfort
Enables pregnant women to remain active with greater comfort

products.name: Pelvic Belt
features: Narrow targeted belt applies compression directly over the sacroiliac joints
Non-stretch centre panel focuses force at the posterior pelvis
Adjustable elastic side wings for a stable, secure fit
Can be worn over or under clothing
benefits: Stabilises the sacroiliac joint to relieve SI joint dysfunction and pelvic girdle pain
Reduces symphysis pubis dysfunction discomfort during walking and stair climbing
Supports the pelvis post-partum as ligaments regain their pre-pregnancy tension
Used in conservative management of pelvic fractures and instability

products.name: Hernia Belt
features: Targeted pressure pad positioned directly over the hernia site
Firm elastic waistband distributes compression evenly
Anatomically shaped to conform to the groin or abdominal region
Adjustable strap ensures the pad stays correctly positioned
benefits: Prevents hernia protrusion during standing, walking, and physical activity
Reduces discomfort associated with inguinal and umbilical hernias
Supports patients awaiting hernia repair surgery
Provides post-operative compression to the repair site during early healing
